# Fixture for redact regex regression. Lines use placeholders (`__SK_LIVE__`,
# `__GHP__`, `__GH_PAT__`, `__XOXB__`, `__XOXP__`, `__AKIA__`, `__SK_OPENAI__`)
# that the test loader rewrites back to real-shape prefixes (`sk_live_`,
# `ghp_`, …) before applying the redactor. Storing the real prefixes verbatim
# trips GitHub Push Protection's secret scanner even on obviously-fake values,
# so we obfuscate at rest and reconstruct in code.
#
# Add new payloads here when the redact regex set grows.
